title: Image statistics
description: Size and intensity of the entity's image stack, with its average and maximum projections saved as images, and each frame's statistics (dev's PixelStatCalculator: mean, minimum, maximum, standard deviation, median and the 0.005, 0.05, 99.95 and 99.995 percentiles), which the signals dialog plots over the frames, as dev's plotImageStats. Fills the ophys.image_stats columns.

stack.title: Stack
stack.description: Variable that holds the image stack (height x width x frames).

averageOutput.title: Average projection
averageOutput.description: Variable the average over frames is saved to. Leave empty to not save it.

maximumOutput.title: Maximum projection
maximumOutput.description: Variable the maximum over frames is saved to. Leave empty to not save it.

frameStatsOutput.title: Frame statistics
frameStatsOutput.description: Variable each frame's mean, minimum, maximum, standard deviation, median and 0.005, 0.05, 99.95 and 99.995 percentiles (frames x 9) are saved to. Leave empty to not save it.

firstFrame.title: First frame
firstFrame.description: The first frame to process, from 1 (dev's frame interval): the method works on frames firstFrame..lastFrame only, and its outputs have that many frames.

lastFrame.title: Last frame
lastFrame.description: The last frame to process; 0 for the last frame of the stack.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Of a stack with channels (height x width x channels x frames): the one to use, from 1

plane.title: Plane
plane.description: Of a stack with planes (height x width x channels x planes x frames): the one to use, from 1, or 0 for every plane, one after the other, in one run
